subject.title: feat(gateway): session dashboard domain — board RPCs, ticketed widgets, dashboard tool, per-agent persistence

question: Should board v1 support `mcp-app` widgets now, or should this PR restrict the public board contract to HTML widgets until maintainers approve a renderable and authorized MCP-app integration?
rationale: The branch publishes `mcp-app` in a new gateway protocol, but neither the supplied route nor snapshot contract provides a usable authorized rendering path; choosing the permanent API shape is a product and compatibility decision.

options.title: Ship HTML-only board v1
options.body: Remove or reject `mcp-app` widget creation in this PR, then add it later with a separately reviewed rendering contract.

options.title: Define the MCP-app contract now
options.body: Add an authorized descriptor or ticketed rendering path, client follow-through, and compatibility tests before exposing `mcp-app` publicly.

options.title: Pause the board protocol
options.body: Hold the feature until the dashboard UI and MCP-app ownership model are jointly settled.

recommendation.title: Ship HTML-only board v1
recommendation.body: Remove or reject `mcp-app` widget creation in this PR, then add it later with a separately reviewed rendering contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged dashboard foundation and this protocol/persistence implementation, so they have the strongest direct context for the proposed v1 boundary.
